notes: Every advisory that survives `pnpm audit` needs a record here, and every
GHSA listed in pnpm-workspace.yaml auditConfig.ignoreGhsas needs a record
with `suppressed: true`. `pnpm audit:policy` enforces both directions and
fails once a record passes its recheckBy date, so an accepted risk cannot
moderate and low records below are therefore non-blocking, but they are
still tracked so the runtime graph stays auditable for downstream

accepted.exploitability: Affects BetaLocalFilesystemMemoryTool, which creates memory files with Node default modes (0o666/0o777). Verified unused: no SMRT package references BetaLocalFilesystemMemoryTool or any local-filesystem memory tool, so the vulnerable code path is not constructed. Impact would require a consumer to instantiate that beta tool directly.
accepted.decision: Not overridable here without pinning a dependency owned by @happyvertical/ai. Overriding a 0.x SDK minor underneath a package that compiled against 0.90 risks a runtime API mismatch for every AI-using SMRT package.
accepted.remediation: Upstream: release @happyvertical/ai with @anthropic-ai/sdk >=0.91.1, then raise the catalog pin here.

accepted.exploitability: Only v3()/v5()/v6() are affected, and only when the caller passes an undersized output buffer or large offset. Verified not reachable: gaxios calls uuid.v4 exclusively, which already throws RangeError on out-of-range writes.
accepted.decision: Reaching the patched line means forcing uuid 8.x/9.x consumers across two majors (9 -> 11 drops the CommonJS default export), which would break google-auth-library's import form for no security gain on an unreachable path.
accepted.remediation: Clears itself when google-auth-library/gaxios move to uuid >=11. Recheck rather than force.

accepted.exploitability: W3CBaggagePropagator.extract() does not bound inbound `baggage` header size. Requires an attacker-supplied inbound baggage header to reach a service with Sentry/OTel HTTP instrumentation active. SMRT does not configure baggage propagation itself; exposure depends on the consumer enabling Sentry tracing on a public endpoint.
accepted.decision: OpenTelemetry packages are versioned as a matched suite. Forcing @opentelemetry/core alone ahead of the sdk-trace-base/instrumentation versions that @sentry/node pins is a known source of runtime breakage, and the whole suite is owned upstream by @happyvertical/logger.
accepted.remediation: Upstream: @happyvertical/logger picks up a @sentry/node release built on @opentelemetry/core >=2.8.0.

accepted.exploitability: Path traversal in `serve-static` via encoded backslash (%5C), and only on Windows hosts. Verified not reachable: no SMRT package uses hono's serveStatic; the MCP SDK uses @hono/node-server for JSON transport, not static file serving.
accepted.decision: The patched line is a major bump (1.x -> 2.x) inside @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's dependency range. Forcing it would put the MCP transport on an unvetted major to fix a path that is not constructed.

accepted.exploitability: Out-of-bounds characters in a cookie name/path/domain can inject additional cookie attributes. Requires attacker-controlled cookie NAMES, not values. Reached only through a dev-time adapter dependency, so it is absent from the published runtime graph.
accepted.decision: Left to @sveltejs/kit's own pin. Forcing cookie across a minor underneath SvelteKit's SSR cookie handling carries more regression risk than a dev-only low warrants.
accepted.remediation: Clears when @sveltejs/adapter-auto's kit pin moves to cookie >=0.7.0.
